name: Genes, alleles, and ploidy
learning_objective: Locate alleles on homologous chromosomes and trace haploid gametes to a diploid zygote.

name: Genotype, phenotype, and complete dominance
name_zh: 基因型、表型与完全显性
learning_objective: Distinguish genotype from phenotype, homozygotes from heterozygotes, and dominance from allele loss.

name: Monohybrid crosses and Punnett probabilities
name_zh: 单因子杂交与庞尼特方格
learning_objective: Calculate gamete, genotype, and phenotype probabilities, including conditional F2 proportions.

name: Test crosses and sampling uncertainty
learning_objective: Infer an unknown dominant-expressing genotype using a recessive tester and interpret finite samples.

name: Recessive pedigrees and carrier inference
name_zh: 隐性遗传家系与携带者推断
learning_objective: Use a recessive pedigree to infer obligate carriers while retaining genuinely unknown genotypes.

name: Incomplete dominance
learning_objective: Predict intermediate heterozygotes and distinguish intermediate phenotype from irreversible allele blending.

name: Codominance and MN blood groups
name_zh: 共显性与 MN 血型
learning_objective: Explain simultaneous expression of both alleles and predict distinct MN phenotypes.

name: Multiple alleles, wild type, and gene-product effects
name_zh: 复等位基因、野生型与基因产物效应
learning_objective: Distinguish population diversity from individual copy number; interpret rabbit alleles, mutant dominance, and the haploid parasite example.

name: X-linked inheritance and hemizygosity
name_zh: X 连锁遗传与半合子
learning_objective: Trace X-linked alleles by offspring sex, distinguish reciprocal crosses, and interpret carriers within the stated model.

name: Lethal alleles and survival-conditioned ratios
name_zh: 致死等位基因与存活者比例
learning_objective: Distinguish recessive from dominant lethality, normalize survivor ratios, and explain delayed-onset transmission.
